Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.

APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [continuous-contour-pose] Define the pose with one readable outer contour and only a few intentional interior contours at the face, hands, garment folds, or major form transitions; allow curves to flow without turning into a heavy graphic outline.
- [simplified-surface-modeling] Use smooth, economical value transitions to turn the major forms; keep shadow shapes broad and subordinate to contour, and preserve the user's requested light direction and skin or clothing tone.
- [shallow-quiet-stage] Keep the background visually quiet and spatially shallow enough for the figure contour to remain distinct; retain any setting details the user specifically requests.
- [silhouette-led-figure-with-restraint] Make contour and pose the first read, use restrained modeling for volume, and keep background depth subordinate without changing the user-defined person or scene.

scope.description: A context-specific figure-painting direction in which a clear, continuous silhouette and a few carefully placed interior contours organize the pose. Form is modeled with smooth, restrained value shifts and a shallow, quiet setting. The direction controls line, silhouette, and modeling; it does not prescribe nudity, costume, pose, identity, or allegorical subject matter.
limitations: Apply only when the user requests a painted human figure or portrait.
Preserve the user's clothing, pose, identity, body type, age, and framing.
Use contour to clarify the requested figure; do not force an idealized or elongated body shape.
Do not add classical costume, nude body, prop, inscription, or allegorical setting unless requested.
Do not reproduce a named figure, pose, or composition.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a single painted human figure or portrait where the pose is central.
rules.instruction: Define the pose with one readable outer contour and only a few intentional interior contours at the face, hands, garment folds, or major form transitions; allow curves to flow without turning into a heavy graphic outline.
rules.observable: The pose and silhouette read clearly at thumbnail scale, while internal lines remain selective.
rules.reject_when: The figure is enclosed by a uniform black outline, broken into unrelated contour fragments, or changed to match a known pose.
rules.avoid: uniform dark outlining, decorative filigree, and copied silhouette

rules.applies_when: The requested figure is painted with visible volume but does not require dramatic lighting.
rules.instruction: Use smooth, economical value transitions to turn the major forms; keep shadow shapes broad and subordinate to contour, and preserve the user's requested light direction and skin or clothing tone.
rules.observable: Volume reads without thick impasto or high-contrast chiaroscuro overpowering the line.
rules.reject_when: The figure becomes flat line art, heavily sculpted by theatrical shadow, or anatomically idealized against the user's request.
rules.avoid: dramatic chiaroscuro, airbrushed plastic skin, and broad global blur

rules.applies_when: The user's requested scene includes a background behind a figure.
rules.instruction: Keep the background visually quiet and spatially shallow enough for the figure contour to remain distinct; retain any setting details the user specifically requests.
rules.observable: Figure and background separate clearly without a forced studio void or invented architecture.
rules.reject_when: Background scenery competes with the figure or removes a user-requested location.
rules.avoid: default classical interior, landscape props, and unrequested narrative setting

joint_checks.instruction: Make contour and pose the first read, use restrained modeling for volume, and keep background depth subordinate without changing the user-defined person or scene.
joint_checks.observable: The requested person and pose remain recognizable; contour is continuous but not uniformly outlined; shadows stay controlled; no default costume or allegory appears.
